articles.summary: Your vote is important no matter how many Allied Gold shares you own. The Board of Directors of Allied Gold Corporation unanimously recommends that Shareholders vote FOR the Arrangement Resolution. Shareholders who have questions or need assistance with voting may contact Allied Gold’s proxy solicitation agent, Laurel Hill Advisory Group, by calling or texting “INFO” to 1-877-452-7184 (toll free in North America), or 1-416-304-0211 (collect outside of North America), or by e-mail at assistance@l
